---
title: "Plan mensual"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Plan mensual</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Planifica el mes, revisa su ejecución y concentra los ajustes sin mezclar los tres flujos.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-actions">
    <span class="tf-plan-save-state" id="monthly-plan-save-state">Plan cargado</span>
    <button id="mp-save" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Guardar plan</button>
    <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="tf-card tf-monthly-plan-overview">
  <div class="tf-budget-period-nav" aria-label="Mes visible del plan">
    <button id="monthly-plan-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes anterior">‹</button>
    <button id="monthly-plan-period-label" type="button" class="tf-budget-period-label">—</button>
    <button id="monthly-plan-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes siguiente">›</button>
  </div>
  <button id="monthly-plan-today" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button" hidden>Ir al mes actual</button>
  <input id="monthly-plan-month" type="hidden">

  <div class="tf-plan-summary-row" aria-label="Resumen del plan mensual">
    <div class="tf-plan-summary-cell"><span>Ingresos previstos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-income">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-plan-summary-cell"><span>Compromisos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-fixed">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-plan-summary-cell"><span>Ahorro</span><strong id="mp-kpi-saving">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-plan-summary-cell"><span>Presupuestos</span><strong id="mp-kpi-variable">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-plan-summary-cell is-result"><span>Disponible</span><strong id="mp-kpi-free">$0,00</strong></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-plan-equation" aria-label="Ecuación del disponible">
    <strong id="mp-eq-income">$0,00</strong><span>−</span><strong id="mp-eq-fixed">$0,00</strong><span>−</span><strong id="mp-eq-saving">$0,00</strong><span>−</span><strong id="mp-eq-variable">$0,00</strong><span>=</span><strong id="mp-free-hero">$0,00</strong>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="monthly-plan-warning" class="tf-alert tf-alert-error"></div>

<nav class="tf-plan-tabs" aria-label="Secciones del plan mensual">
  <button type="button" class="tf-plan-tab is-active" data-mp-tab="plan">Plan</button>
  <button type="button" class="tf-plan-tab" data-mp-tab="execution">Ejecución</button>
  <button type="button" class="tf-plan-tab" data-mp-tab="adjustments">Ajustes</button>
</nav>

<section class="tf-plan-tab-panel" data-mp-panel="plan">
  <div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2 tf-monthly-plan-main">
    <div class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Entrada</div><h2>Ingresos previstos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Ingresos recurrentes y fuentes automáticas incluidas.</div></div><strong id="mp-income-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div id="mp-income-list" class="tf-plan-source-list"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Obligaciones</div><h2>Compromisos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Recurrentes, préstamos, tarjetas, seguros y otros compromisos.</div></div><strong id="mp-fixed-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div id="mp-fixed-list" class="tf-plan-source-list"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Objetivos</div><h2>Ahorro</h2><div class="tf-muted">Aporte sugerido por metas o valor manual para este mes.</div></div><strong id="mp-saving-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div id="mp-goal-list" class="tf-plan-source-list"></div>
      <div class="tf-plan-saving-control">
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Ahorro del mes ($)</label><input id="mp-saving-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"><small id="mp-saving-help"></small></div>
        <button id="mp-use-auto-saving" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Usar ahorro sugerido</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Presupuestos</div><h2>Reservas del mes</h2><div class="tf-muted">Presupuestos del mes, incluyendo rollover cuando corresponda.</div></div><strong id="mp-variable-total" class="tf-plan-section-total">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div id="mp-variable-list" class="tf-plan-source-list"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="tf-plan-tab-panel" data-mp-panel="execution" hidden>
  <section class="tf-card">
    <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Real</div><h2>Ejecución registrada</h2><div class="tf-muted">Movimientos ya registrados. No altera el disponible planificado.</div></div></div>
    <div class="tf-plan-execution-row">
      <div><span>Ingresos reales</span><strong id="mp-real-income">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div><span>Egresos de caja</span><strong id="mp-real-expense">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div><span>Pagos de tarjeta</span><strong id="mp-real-card">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div><span>Préstamos pagados</span><strong id="mp-real-loan">$0,00</strong></div>
      <div class="is-result"><span>Flujo registrado</span><strong id="mp-real-net">$0,00</strong></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tf-subtle" style="margin-top:1rem">Una compra con tarjeta no se trata como salida de caja hasta registrar el pago.</div>
  </section>
</section>

<section class="tf-plan-tab-panel" data-mp-panel="adjustments" hidden>
  <div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2">
    <section class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Excepciones</div><h2>Ajustes manuales</h2><div class="tf-muted">Agrega únicamente lo que no existe ya como fuente automática.</div></div></div>
      <form id="mp-manual-form" class="tf-form-grid">
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="mp-manual-type"><option value="income">Ingreso adicional</option><option value="commitment">Compromiso adicional</option><option value="savings">Ahorro adicional</option><option value="reserve">Reserva variable adicional</option></select></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Concepto</label><input id="mp-manual-label" required placeholder="Ej. Bono, matrícula"></div>
        <div class="tf-field"><label>Monto ($)</label><input id="mp-manual-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
        <div class="tf-field" style="display:flex;align-items:end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Agregar ajuste</button></div>
      </form>
      <div id="mp-manual-list" class="tf-plan-manual-list" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
    </section>
    <section class="tf-card">
      <div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Configuración</div><h2>Notas y restablecimiento</h2></div></div>
      <div class="tf-field"><label>Nota del plan</label><textarea id="mp-note" placeholder="Ej. Mes con matrícula, viaje o ingreso extraordinario"></textarea></div>
      <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.8rem"><button id="mp-reset-auto" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Restablecer automático</button></div>
    </section>
  </div>
</section>

<dialog id="monthly-plan-month-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog tf-budget-month-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Período</div><h3>Seleccionar mes</h3></div><button id="monthly-plan-month-dialog-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button></div>
  <div class="tf-budget-year-nav"><button id="monthly-plan-year-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año anterior">‹</button><strong id="monthly-plan-picker-year">2026</strong><button id="monthly-plan-year-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año siguiente">›</button></div>
  <div id="monthly-plan-month-grid" class="tf-budget-month-grid"></div>
  <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.8rem"><button id="monthly-plan-picker-current" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Mes actual</button></div>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/monthly-plan.js?v=1.0.84"></script>
```
